title: Rust lichen-gateway: COSE_Sign1 decode + Schnorr48 capability verification (mirror python ordering)
description: Child of 7nnl. Port python/src/lichen/crypto/capability_announcements.py from_cose_sign1:199-232 + verify:279-333 to Rust: COSE_Sign1 decode (kid == announcer_iid, alg -65537), verification ordering: reserved bits 2-7 zero -> IID match -> signature (Schnorr48 over SHA-256 Sig_structure) -> expiry -> seq > cached (replay). Vectors exist: test/vectors/capability_announcements.json — drive the tests from it (independent oracle = python impl + vectors). Cross-check the Rust Schnorr48 verify (schnorr48 crate) signature semantics against python's before wiring. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-7nnl.
close_reason: COSE_Sign1 decode + Schnorr48 verification landed (commit 914b46c440, rust/lichen-gateway/src/capability_announcements.rs + lib.rs registration, 412 lines): from_cose_sign1 decodes the CBOR tag-18-wrapped COSE_Sign1 (ciborium), validates the protected header alg -65537 and the kid==announcer_iid binding (decode-stage, mirroring python from_cose_sign1 raising ValueError); verify_announcement applies the spec 8.12 ordering exactly: reserved bits 2-7 zero -> IID match (ygg_addr_from_pubkey derived) -> Schnorr48 signature over SHA-256 Sig_structure (["Signature1", protected, h'', payload], RFC 9052) -> expiry > now -> seq > cached replay check; error strings mirror python (RESERVED_BITS_SET/IID_MISMATCH/SIGNATURE_INVALID/EXPIRED/REPLAY_DETECTED). Transcript integrity: the raw payload bytes from the wire are used for the Sig_structure (no re-encoding risk). Tests consume test/vectors/capability_announcements.json (9 vectors, independent oracle): all decode + signature-verify, capability_invalid_reserved_bits -> ReservedBitsSet, capability_iid_mismatch -> decode-stage KidMismatch (matching python), plus expiry boundary (1735689599 ok / 1735689600 EXPIRED), replay semantics (cached below ok, equal REPLAY_DETECTED), and malformed-input rejection. sha2 dep added to lichen-gateway Cargo.toml (ciborium already present). Verification: lichen-gateway lib 233 passed / 0 failed; clippy clean on the new module; fmt clean. Codereview 3x delegated to kimi-k3 (rounds: earlier verification of the module in progress + this commit) — during development the reviewer-vector loop caught: CBOR tag-18 unwrap requirement, the iid_mismatch decode-stage failure (test adjusted to expect decode failure per python), and an inverted replay-semantics test assertion (fixed). Sibling 7nnl.3 (gateway dispatch wiring) consumes this module + 7nnl.1's table.
